name: Snowfell and the Shattered Glass
source:
It has started snowing in the City of Savannah.  This is a miracle!  Too good to be true! While not an impossible event, there has never been this much snow in this city.  Join the main characters from the webcomic, [url=https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/all-nighter-survival-guide/list?title_no=866288]All Nighter Survival Guide[/url], in this story book adventure based on Hans Christian Anderson's “Snow Queen”.

While snowed into their apartment Sin receives a mysterious letter asking them to venture into the snow.  Together The college student and the Supernatural Shadow journey into the world of Snowfell to stop the raging storm. 

[Edited from [url=https://allnightersurvivalguide.itch.io/snowfell-and-the-shattered-glass]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
萨凡纳市已经开始下雪。这真是一个奇迹！好得令人难以置信！虽然这不是不可能的事情，但这座城市从来没有下过这么大的雪。与网络漫画 [url=https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/all-nighter-survival-guide/list?title_no=866288]《通宵生存指南》[/url] 中的主要角色一起，体验这部基于汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安德森 (Hans Christian Anderson) 的《雪之女王》的故事书冒险故事。

当大雪进入他们的公寓时，辛收到一封神秘的信，要求他们冒险进入雪地。大学生和超自然之影一起前往雪山世界阻止肆虐的风暴。

[编辑自[url=https://allnightersurvivalguide.itch.io/snowfell-and-the-shattered-glass]itch.io[/url]]
